item.title: Easy High Protein Meals for Busy Weeknights: A 5-Night Dinner Plan
item.description: Easy high protein meals for busy weeknights, planned as five dinners. Chicken, turkey, salmon, eggs and beans are the stars, with swaps for what is in your kitchen. Short ingredient lists and quick steps. Guide contains affiliate links.
